cc:Work.dc:title: Misc - MakitaPowerSupply
cc:Work.dc:description:
Bench power supply powered with Maktia 18V battery or laptop power supply
Vitamins: DSP5005 (or similar) power supply, two banana sockets, two 4.8mm flat terminals with flat soldering tag
To allow powering by laptop power supply: flip switch, Lenovo round socket (or adjust right hole for different socket)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes MakitaPowerSupply --secondary_power usb-c --banana_socket_diameter 7 --flipswitch_diameter 6 --thickness 4 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes MakitaPowerSupply --secondary_power --banana_socket_diameter --flipswitch_diameter --thickness --reference --labels
